loss: BCEWithLogits, equal-CVE mean after training-only balanced class weights
selection: Strict improvement in validation average precision; earliest epoch wins ties; no threshold tuning.
interpretation: Retrospective VulnCheck listing classification; not future exploitation or historical Day-30 prediction.
matching: Same CVEs, exact description text, frozen SecBERT embeddings, train-fitted structured vectors, head, loss, optimizer and seeds. Different encoder capacities and graph-node populations are reported, not claimed equal.
source_policy: vulncheck_source_policy_v2; accepted description only. Summary and SMP text and masks are not used.
cache_policy: Canonical source IDs map exact descriptions to prior cache identity. Reuse requires matching full entry, resource/code identity and locked hashes; missing chunks use the frozen PS01 v2 builder.
extraction: Fixed security v4 candidate extractor; GNN learns from saved relation types/evidence, not a newly trained relation extractor.
evaluation: Same 2870 train/1104 validation roles. All VK03 logistic references remain; no test scoring, test-derived selection or significance claim. Previously observed test is not a fresh holdout.
training_execution: User launches full fits. Smoke is integration only. Completed fits can be resumed read-only; incomplete fits restart deterministically.
